From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com, sam.ellis@novushealth.com
Date: 2026-11-08T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Service interruption 2026-11-07 — request for credit calculation

Hi all — I ran the tokenized calculation against Novus's usage for Nov 1–8 and isolated the affected window. Notes below and attached workbook (cred_calc_tokenized_v1.xlsx):

Summary:
- Eligible downtime window: 2026-11-07 03:40–04:55 UTC (1 hour 15 minutes of sustained degradation flagged across three routes).
- Billable token adjustment method: we apply the per-route average tokens/minute during healthy periods, subtract observed served tokens, and prorate the monthly committed units.
- Calculated eligible credit: 9.2% of Nov tiered usage for the affected routes. This maps to a credit of $12,448.00 based on Novus’s current rate card and committed units. Line items in sheet.

Assumptions & caveats:
- We only include fully failed/minimally-serving intervals above our 5% degradation threshold per SLA clause 3.2.
- Caching/prefix hits were excluded where they did not materially change billable tokens.
- If Novus prefers a seat-by-seat offset vs. invoice credit, we can change route.

Attachments: cred_calc_tokenized_v1.xlsx (Excel) — contains per-route token time-series and the final credit worksheet.

Next steps: Rachel/Ben, please advise on approval path (finance threshold for credit issuance) and whether legal needs a redlined credit memo. Sam, confirm if Novus wants the credit as an invoice adjustment or a one-time credit memo.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
SRE & Remediation Lead — Redwood Inference
